annotations.summary: The FinanceOS server is logging a lot of errors — more than 5 in the last 15 minutes. Something is failing repeatedly.
annotations.description: Open Grafana → Service Health dashboard → ERROR logs panel to see which feature is breaking and grab the errorId.

annotations.summary: AI features are failing — a request tried every AI provider in the failover chain and all of them errored.
annotations.description: Usually a rate limit (429) or a bad/expired API key (401). Open Grafana → LLM Providers dashboard to see which provider failed and why.

annotations.summary: The background job "{{ $labels.jobName }}" (job {{ $labels.jobId }}, user {{ $labels.userId }}) crashed with {{ $labels.errorClass }}: {{ $labels.rootCause }}
annotations.description: The job's work (syncing or refreshing data) did not complete. Search the server logs for jobId {{ $labels.jobId }} to see the full error, or open Grafana → Pipelines dashboard → job outcomes.

model.expr: sum by (jobName, jobId, userId, errorClass, rootCause) (count_over_time({service="financeos-server"} | json | event="job.failed" [30m])) > 0

annotations.summary: An email or item ({{ $labels.itemType }} {{ $labels.itemId }}, user {{ $labels.userId }}) could not be processed ({{ $labels.errorClass }}: {{ $labels.error }}); the rest of the sync continued.
annotations.description: That one item is held back while everything else keeps flowing. Fix the cause named in the error, then open Settings → Debug → Failures to see it and retry after a fix.

model.expr: sum by (userId, itemType, itemId, errorClass, error) (count_over_time({service="financeos-server"} | json | event="ingest.item_failed" [15m])) > 0

annotations.summary: The FinanceOS server app is almost out of memory (above 90% for 10+ minutes) and could crash soon.
annotations.description: If it crashes it will restart and drop whatever it was doing. Check Grafana memory panels for what is eating memory; a restart at a quiet moment clears it short-term.

model.expr: sum by (role) (jvm_memory_used_bytes{service="financeos-server", area="heap"}) / sum by (role) (jvm_memory_max_bytes{service="financeos-server", area="heap"} > 0) > 0.9

annotations.summary: A FinanceOS VM is nearly out of RAM (under 80MB free) - Linux may start killing processes, including the app. The "host" label says which VM.
annotations.description: SSH into that VM (API: 129.159.22.124, worker: financeos-worker) and check what is using memory (`free -m`, `top`). If there is no swap, run deploy/add-swap.sh.

annotations.summary: The server's disk is almost full — less than 15% space left. If it fills up completely, the app and logging stop working.
annotations.description: SSH into the VM and free space: `df -h` to confirm, then clean old logs/files (e.g. `du -sh /var/log/*`).

annotations.summary: Requests have been stuck waiting for a database connection for 5+ minutes — the app will feel slow or frozen.
annotations.description: Usually a slow query hogging connections. Check Grafana → Pipelines dashboard for slow SQL; restart the app if it does not clear.

annotations.summary: No successful Gmail sync in over 2 hours (it runs every 15 minutes): the worker is down, the job keeps failing, or Gmail access expired.
annotations.description: Check Grafana → Pipelines dashboard. Most common causes: the Gmail connection needs re-authorizing, or Gmail API quota ran out.

annotations.summary: Investment prices haven't refreshed in over 26 hours — portfolio values shown in the app are stale.
annotations.description: Check Grafana → Pipelines dashboard, and whether the price sources (Yahoo/AMFI) are reachable from the server.

annotations.summary: Users are hitting server errors — more than 3 requests returned a 500-type error in the last 15 minutes.
annotations.description: Open Grafana → Service Health dashboard and the ERROR logs panel to see which endpoint is failing and why.

annotations.summary: The app is responding slowly: the average request has taken over 1 second for 15+ minutes (chat streaming and actuator excluded).
annotations.description: Check Grafana for slow SQL queries, database pool pressure, and slow external APIs (Gmail, price feeds).

annotations.summary: People can't sign in with Google or connect Gmail — more than 3 login/connect attempts failed in the last 10 minutes.
annotations.description: Check the Google OAuth settings (redirect URIs, consent screen) and look for an app.config.suspect line in the server startup logs.

annotations.summary: The server started up with a configuration that looks wrong (e.g. a bad OAuth redirect URL or cookie origin) — sign-in or Gmail connect may be broken.
annotations.description: Check the server startup logs for the app.config.suspect line; it names the exact setting that looks off.

annotations.summary: Actions in the web app are failing for users — more than 5 saves/clicks errored in the last 10 minutes.
annotations.description: Open Grafana → Client Health dashboard to see which action is failing and its errorId.

annotations.summary: No metrics from the API VM (role=api) for 5 minutes - the API process or its VM is down, or Fluent Bit stopped shipping.
annotations.description: Caddy fails over to the worker VM while the API is down. SSH to the API VM: `systemctl status financeos fluent-bit`, `journalctl -u financeos -n 100`.

annotations.summary: No metrics from the worker VM (role=worker) for 5 minutes - schedulers and the job worker are not running.
annotations.description: SSH to financeos-worker: `systemctl status financeos fluent-bit`, `journalctl -u financeos -n 100`.

annotations.summary: Garbage collection paused the app for more than 15 s in the last 10 minutes on role {{ $labels.role }}.
annotations.description: Usually the VM swapping or the heap too small. Check gc.log on that VM and Grafana memory panels.

annotations.summary: The oldest pending background job has waited more than 15 minutes - the job worker is stuck, paused or down.
annotations.description: Check the worker VM (`journalctl -u financeos`), and that /actuator/jobs on the worker is not paused after a failed deploy.

annotations.summary: The API and worker VMs have run different builds for 45+ minutes (longer than any normal deploy, drain included): a deploy finished on one VM only.
annotations.description: Compare the version label per role in Grafana; re-run the latest Deploy workflow (it rolls a failed host back to its previous JAR), or deploy/deploy-host.sh <host> <user> <label> rollback.

annotations.summary: The op "{{ $labels.op }}" is more than 1.5x slower (p95) than at this time yesterday, with at least 20 calls in the last hour.
annotations.description: Open Grafana, Where the Time Goes dashboard, and compare the op's p95 and stage averages. A deploy in the last day is the usual cause.

model.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (op, le) (rate(financeos_op_seconds_bucket{service="financeos-server",op=~"job\\..*|ext\\..*"}[1h]))) > 1.5 * histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (op, le) (rate(financeos_op_seconds_bucket{service="financeos-server",op=~"job\\..*|ext\\..*"}[1h] offset 1d)))) and on (op) (sum by (op) (increase(financeos_op_seconds_count{service="financeos-server",op=~"job\\..*|ext\\..*"}[1h])) >= 20)

annotations.summary: The op "{{ $labels.op }}" has a p95 over 1 second.
annotations.description: Open Grafana, Where the Time Goes dashboard, p95 by op. job.* ops are excluded because background jobs are slow by design; the regression rule covers them.

model.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (op, le) (rate(financeos_op_seconds_bucket{service="financeos-server",op=~"ext\\..*"}[15m]))) > 1 and on (op) (sum by (op) (increase(financeos_op_seconds_count{service="financeos-server",op=~"ext\\..*"}[15m])) >= 5)

annotations.summary: The route {{ $labels.route }} averages more than 50 database queries per request (an N+1 is likely).
annotations.description: Open Grafana, Where the Time Goes dashboard, DB queries per request, then batch the per-row queries behind that route.

model.expr: sum by (route) (rate(financeos_db_queries_sum{service="financeos-server",route!="none"}[30m])) / sum by (route) (rate(financeos_db_queries_count{service="financeos-server",route!="none"}[30m])) > 50 and on (route) (sum by (route) (increase(financeos_db_queries_count{service="financeos-server",route!="none"}[30m])) >= 10)

annotations.summary: The outside call "{{ $labels.op }}" is failing more than 20% of the time or its p95 is over 5 seconds.
annotations.description: A provider (Gmail, a price feed, an LLM) is slow or erroring, including rate limits (HTTP 429). Open Grafana, Where the Time Goes dashboard, external call panels.

model.expr: (sum by (op) (rate(financeos_op_seconds_count{service="financeos-server",op=~"ext\\..*",outcome="error"}[15m])) / sum by (op) (rate(financeos_op_seconds_count{service="financeos-server",op=~"ext\\..*"}[15m])) > 0.2 and on (op) sum by (op) (increase(financeos_op_seconds_count{service="financeos-server",op=~"ext\\..*"}[15m])) >= 5) or (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (op, le) (rate(financeos_op_seconds_bucket{service="financeos-server",op=~"ext\\..*"}[15m]))) > 5)

annotations.summary: For one bank, fewer than half of the statements read in the last 24 hours were accepted automatically (at least 10 files, not counting problems the user caused such as locked or unsupported files). The statement parser may have broken for that bank's layout.
annotations.description: The issuer label names the bank. In Grafana Explore, run sum by (issuer, outcome, kind, verdict) (increase(financeos_statement_parse_total[24h])) to see whether files failed, were blocked or only need review, then re-run the parser corpus for that bank.

model.expr: (sum by (issuer) (increase(financeos_statement_parse_total{service="financeos-server", issuer!="unknown", kind!~"LOCKED|UNSUPPORTED_TYPE|EMPTY_FILE|TOO_MANY_PAGES|NO_TEXT_LAYER|NOT_A_STATEMENT", outcome=~"parsed|blocked|failed"}[24h])) >= 10) and ((((sum by (issuer) (increase(financeos_statement_parse_total{service="financeos-server", issuer!="unknown", kind!~"LOCKED|UNSUPPORTED_TYPE|EMPTY_FILE|TOO_MANY_PAGES|NO_TEXT_LAYER|NOT_A_STATEMENT", outcome="parsed", verdict="AUTO_INGEST"}[24h]))) or (0 * sum by (issuer) (increase(financeos_statement_parse_total{service="financeos-server", issuer!="unknown", kind!~"LOCKED|UNSUPPORTED_TYPE|EMPTY_FILE|TOO_MANY_PAGES|NO_TEXT_LAYER|NOT_A_STATEMENT", outcome=~"parsed|blocked|failed"}[24h])))) / sum by (issuer) (increase(financeos_statement_parse_total{service="financeos-server", issuer!="unknown", kind!~"LOCKED|UNSUPPORTED_TYPE|EMPTY_FILE|TOO_MANY_PAGES|NO_TEXT_LAYER|NOT_A_STATEMENT", outcome=~"parsed|blocked|failed"}[24h]))) < 0.5)

annotations.summary: Grafana Cloud active series are over 8000 (the budget). A new label or op may be exploding cardinality.
annotations.description: Check which metric grew (Grafana Explore, count by (__name__)) and fix the label that grew before the bill does.
